data.title: bn-mri: Typed preview palette metadata
data.description: For bn-mri: add strict optional __meta__ preview_palette parsing, an identity-default typed core accessor, tooling-only semantics, parser regressions, and authoritative docs. Full just check passes.

data.body: MEDIUM: This sentence overstates both the current implementation and the runtime model. In this change, no sprite/map preview consumer reads preview_palette yet (that is tracked separately by bn-1n7), while pal(c0,c1,0) explicitly rewrites framebuffer pixels, so framebuffer indices and screen_text are not generally in authored source-index space. Please phrase the invariant as 'preview_palette itself does not affect runtime or raw authoring surfaces' and either mark static-preview application as forthcoming or land the consumer before claiming previews use it.

MEDIUM: The central compatibility promise ('the runtime deliberately ignores this mapping') is currently established only by code inspection. Add a regression that constructs equivalent Console carts with and without preview_palette, steps them, and compares framebuffer plus display_palette. That will prevent a later from_cart refactor from accidentally treating tooling metadata as initial runtime palette state.

data.reason: LGTM: parser boundaries and identity/partial/full mappings are correct; console-core tests and clippy pass; no blocking runtime compatibility defect. Two medium follow-ups request precise current-state docs and a direct runtime-isolation regression.

data.body: Fixed in 74782fa: wording now states preview_palette itself has no runtime or raw-authoring effect and identifies static previews only as the intended tooling consumer, without claiming the dependent renderer is already present.
Fixed in 74782fa: added a direct with/without-metadata Console regression across four frames, including draw-pal and display-pal changes, comparing framebuffer and display_palette after every step.

Verified in 74782fa: the SPEC and skill now describe preview_palette as tooling-only metadata, avoid claiming the dependent preview renderer has already landed, and no longer mislabel draw-pal framebuffer output as authored source space. Resolved.
